description: Abstract class implementing matcher processing logic for the Goteo crowdfunding platform, including user amount distribution, investment list creation, and event listener configuration.

classes.name: AbstractMatcherProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class providing core functionality for processing matchers, including user amount calculations, investment creation, and event listener definitions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a simplified class name identifier for the matcher processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the matcher processor.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns a description of the matcher processor (default empty).

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a given matcher corresponds to this processor.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the processor if the matcher is valid for it.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for variables used in the processor (default empty).

methods.name: getVars
methods.description: Retrieves variables, combining default and custom variables.

methods.name: getUserAmounts
methods.description: Calculates and returns the distribution of a total amount among users based on their pool shares.

methods.name: getInvests
methods.description: Generates a list of investment objects based on the matcher and amount.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Sets the matcher object for processing.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Sets the project context for the processor.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the project context, throws exception if not set.

methods.name: getAppEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default application event listeners for the matcher processor.

methods.name: getConsoleEventListeners
methods.description: Returns default console event listeners for the matcher processor.
